policy.exactDefinition: Git mode, object type, and blob object ID all match the pinned upstream commit.
policy.exceptionRule: Every non-identical upstream-owned path must remain explicitly listed with a reviewed reason code.
policy.localOnlyRule: Paths absent from the pinned upstream tree are local extensions and are listed separately.
policy.selfReferentialManifestRule: The parity manifest is classified by its path, not its generated bytes, so a working-tree manifest can verify itself safely.

exceptionReasons.auth-ownership-transaction: Local authentication, ownership, revision, and transactional workspace contracts intentionally extend the upstream backend.
exceptionReasons.authored-export-runtime: Local authored, PDF/PPTX, Electron, and bounded export-runtime behavior is protected by dedicated regression and security tests.
exceptionReasons.compatibility-control: Local compatibility policy, ledgers, CI, and verification code have no upstream byte-for-byte counterpart.
exceptionReasons.local-fork-replacement: The fork intentionally replaces or removes this upstream path; the path remains an explicit reviewed exception rather than an implicit drift.
exceptionReasons.studio-template-v2: Local Template V2 Studio editing, strict validation, table round-trip, and lossless payload adapters extend the upstream editor contract.
exceptionReasons.tiptap3-editor-adapter: The local editor preserves the Tiptap 3 contract while upstream editor sources currently target Tiptap 2 APIs.
